Definition: {meaning accession (used as an adverb or conjunction); also or yea; adversatively though}
BiblicalUsage: Also, yea, even — Daniel telling the king that he has done no hurt before God, and also none before the king, and the elders of Judah asking the names of the men building the temple. The word adds one more thing to the list, and in Daniel's mouth it is the whole defence.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Daniel's little word carries his whole case: innocent before God, and innocent before the king too.
